headerDisplay: Sony Projector Unified / 索尼投影仪综合控制。支持 ADCP 和 PJ Talk。默认不自动开机，高级控制及投影就绪、冷却中传感器请在 Feature Options 按需开启。
footerDisplay: Run this plugin as a [child bridge](https://github.com/homebridge/homebridge/wiki/Child-Bridges). Each projector appears as its own TV accessory: add it in the Home app with **Add Accessory > More options** and your Homebridge setup code.

name.title: Name / 名称
name.description: How the projector is named in HomeKit.

host.title: IP address or hostname / 地址
host.description: Give the projector a fixed address (a DHCP reservation) so it does not change.

oneOf.title: SDCP / PJ Talk: older VPL-VW and VPL-HW

password.title: Administrator password / 管理员密码
password.description: 默认 Projector，可手动修改为投影仪当前管理员密码。留空表示不提供密码；无认证模式会自动识别。 如需免密码控制，请在投影仪网页 ADCP 设置中关闭 Requires Authentication；保持开启则填写管理员密码。插件自动识别认证状态。

community.title: SDCP community
community.description: Only for SDCP projectors whose PJ Talk community was changed from SONY.

port.title: Port / 端口
port.description: Only needed for a non-standard port. Requires an explicit protocol (ADCP default 53595, SDCP default 53484).

pollInterval.title: Poll interval / 状态同步间隔（秒）
pollInterval.description: How often to check the projector while it is on. Standby is checked three times less often.

id.title: Stable device ID / 固定设备标识
id.description: Set once (for example theater-hw69); keep it unchanged when changing the IP address.

autoPowerOn.title: Auto power on and wait / 自动开机并等待就绪
autoPowerOn.description: Optional. Input, picture and remote controls may wait up to the readiness timeout. Disabled by default.

readyTimeout.title: Readiness timeout / 就绪等待上限（秒）

inputSource.title: TV input picker / 电视输入列表

inputs.title: Inputs / 输入
inputs.description: Optional override of detected tokens; values must match your projector. Leave unset for discovery.

pictureModes.title: Picture modes / 画面模式
pictureModes.description: Optional override of detected tokens; values must match your projector. Leave unset for discovery.

aspects.title: Aspect ratios / 画幅
aspects.description: Optional override of detected tokens; values must match your projector. Leave unset for discovery.

hdrModes.title: HDR modes / HDR 模式
hdrModes.description: Optional override of detected tokens; values must match your projector. Leave unset for discovery.

testPatterns.title: Test patterns / 测试图
testPatterns.description: Optional override of detected tokens; values must match your projector. Leave unset for discovery.

brightness.title: brightness
brightness.description: Optional support override; leave unset for discovery.

contrast.title: contrast
contrast.description: Optional support override; leave unset for discovery.

blank.title: blank
blank.description: Optional support override; leave unset for discovery.

faults.title: faults
faults.description: Optional support override; leave unset for discovery.

lightHours.title: lightHours
lightHours.description: Optional support override; leave unset for discovery.

remote.title: remote
remote.description: Optional support override; leave unset for discovery.

username.title: Administrator username / 管理员用户名
username.description: Web administrator account. ADCP authenticates with the password only.

language.title: Accessory names / 配件名称语言
language.description: Each optional control and sensor is published as a separately named accessory.

options.title: Feature options
options.description: Use the Feature Options tab in this plugin's settings instead of editing these by hand.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Log protocol traffic for troubleshooting. Passwords are never logged.
